items.title: General Motors (GM) Takes 38% Of Thacker Pass In U.S. Lithium Push
items.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) holds a 38% ownership stake in the Thacker Pass lithium project in Nevada. The Thacker Pass project is supported by a large loan from the U.S. Department of Energy as part of a domestic supply push. GM views Thacker Pass as a key source of lithium for future electric vehicle batteries under its long term electrification plans.
